# Tomora

> Tomora is a no-code website builder and online store platform made in Nigeria for African businesses, NGOs, churches, schools, coaches and creators. You pick a professionally designed template, add your brand, photos and products, and publish a live website in minutes on a free subdomain (yourname.tomora.com.ng) or your own domain. Customers pay with Paystack (card, bank transfer, USSD) and the money goes straight into the owner's own bank account. Prices are in Nigerian Naira and there is a free plan with no credit card required.

Website: https://www.tomora.com.ng
Sign up free: https://www.tomora.com.ng/signup
Support: support@tomora.com.ng

## Who Tomora is for

- Small businesses and shops in Nigeria that want to sell online and take payments without a developer
- Fashion, beauty, food and retail sellers who currently sell through WhatsApp or Instagram and want a proper storefront
- NGOs and churches collecting donations, with separate fundraising projects and progress bars
- Coaches, consultants, creators and personal brands who need a professional site fast
- Schools and organisations that need an information website

## What you can build

- [Business websites](https://www.tomora.com.ng): templates for services, portfolios, restaurants, organisations and more, with live editing, custom brand colours, logos, hero images and videos, testimonials and contact forms.
- [Online stores](https://www.tomora.com.ng): product catalogues with photos, prices in Naira, stock, colour and size variants, categories, product pages, cart and Paystack checkout, order management, delivery settings, discount codes and customer reviews.
- [Donation sites](https://www.tomora.com.ng): multiple fundraising projects per site, each with its own target and progress bar.
- [Tomora Academy](https://www.tomora.com.ng/academy): practical video courses, such as building websites and digital products with AI. Creators can also sell their own courses.
- [Free web resources](https://www.tomora.com.ng/resources): copy-ready HTML sections and prompts.
- [Tomora AI](https://www.tomora.com.ng/tomora-ai): a library of premium designs you can customise and copy.

## How it works

1. Create a free account at https://www.tomora.com.ng/signup (no credit card).
2. Choose the kind of website you need and a template.
3. Add your business name, logo, brand colour, headline and photos.
4. Add products or donation projects, and your bank account for payouts.
5. Publish to yourname.tomora.com.ng in one click, or connect your own domain.
6. Track orders, revenue and visits from the dashboard on your phone.

## Pricing (Nigerian Naira)

- Free: ₦0. One website on a Tomora subdomain with online checkout and donations, for as long as you like. A small fixed fee is added to the customer's total at checkout (never taken from your sale): ₦105 under ₦5,000, ₦200 under ₦15,000, ₦250 under ₦30,000, ₦500 under ₦50,000, ₦750 for ₦50,000 and above.
- Starter: ₦4,900 per month. Up to 3 websites, online store, order management, lead capture, no transaction fee. Custom domain available for ₦8,000.
- Growth: ₦9,800 per month. Up to 5 websites, custom domain included, inventory management, customer reviews, no transaction fee.
- Pro: ₦19,800 per month. Up to 10 websites, custom domain included, dedicated account manager, VIP support, no transaction fee.
- One-Time: ₦84,500 for the first year with everything in Pro and a custom domain, then ₦20,000 per year.

Paystack's own processing fee applies on every plan. Current prices are always shown at https://www.tomora.com.ng/#pricing.

## Frequently asked questions

- Is Tomora free? Yes. The Free plan gives one website with online checkout and donations, with no time limit and no credit card.
- Can I use my own domain? Yes. Growth, Pro and One-Time include a custom domain; on Starter one can be added for ₦8,000.
- Does Tomora support Paystack? Yes. Stores collect payments through Paystack straight into the owner's own bank account.
- Can I sell products? Yes. Choose an e-commerce template, add products with images and Naira prices, and buyers check out with Paystack.
- Do I need to know how to code? No. Everything is done by picking a template and filling in your details.
- Does it work on a phone? Yes. Every site is mobile-responsive, and the dashboard is designed to be run from a phone.

## About

Tomora is built and operated in Nigeria and serves businesses across Africa. The main site is https://www.tomora.com.ng.
